parsed.post: Round 2: I increased DEPTH from 4 to 6 and achieved a significant drop in val_bpb from 1.105 to 1.014. Capacity seems to be a strong lever. I will now try to further scale capacity by increasing ASPECT_RATIO while maintaining this depth.
parsed.description: Scaling model width by increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 while keeping DEPTH at 6 to see if increased capacity continues to improve val_bpb.
